title: A direct sum of simple Lie algebras over Q is R-universal exactly under four Brauer-theoretic conditions
author: Dave Witte Morris
work: A Cohomological Proof that Real Representations of Semisimple Lie Algebras Have Q-Forms
source_version: Official SIGMA 11 (2015) article 034, DOI 10.3842/SIGMA.2015.034; journal PDF and native TeX acquired 2026-10-01, exact bytes pinned by SHA256
difficulty_reason: The counted statement is the author's structure proposition for a direct sum of simple Lie algebras over Q (source lines 885-909): R-universality is equivalent to four simultaneous conditions on the simple factors, on the star-action, and on the Tits algebras of the factors. The proof (source lines 911-946) is not a routine assembly of earlier statements: condition (3) is a computation in the Brauer group, where the real division algebras attached to lambda_i and lambda_j are tensored, R-universality of the sum is used to force the tensor product to be Brauer equivalent to Q, and the conclusion that the two quaternion algebras are isomorphic uses that they are quaternion algebras (proof lines 921-932). Condition (4) needs the choice of an outer factor and a weight moved by the star-action before the restriction to the splitting field L, and it consumes the author's fourth description of R-universality through the division algebra D(Lie G, Q)(lambda) (proof lines 934-945). The two external lemmas it invokes, SameFixed and RunivIff, are navigation pointers only; the parts of the argument that use them are one-line appeals. H2.
